summary: Frontend E2E of the 'Copy invite link' enhancement to Team Management. All 8 user-journey assertions passed on preview: button rendering (Link2 icon only on pending+invite_link rows next to RotateCcw/Trash2), clipboard write via navigator.clipboard, transient Check-icon feedback that reverts to Link2 after ~2s, helper-text update with inline Link2 icon mentioning the copy option, public /team/accept-invite page binds strictly to the invited email+role, password submission creates account whose /auth/me email EXACTLY matches the invited address (team_member tier, is_admin=false), resend rotates the invite_link token and the old token now returns {valid:false} from GET /team/invite/{token}. One environment issue surfaced below.

minor.issue: Hardcoded fallback 'https://auremcto.com' when FRONTEND_URL env var is unset. In this preview pod FRONTEND_URL is not set, so copied invite_link URLs point to the PROD domain (auremcto.com) even though the invite token exists only in preview Mongo — opening the copied link out-of-the-box in preview takes users to a page where the token is invalid. Prod itself is fine because FRONTEND_URL=auremcto.com effectively matches. Fix: set FRONTEND_URL=https://bin-context-pat.preview.emergentagent.com in /app/backend/.env, OR derive the base from the request's X-Forwarded-Host/origin header, OR use REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL (same host as frontend in this setup) as the fallback instead of a hardcoded prod URL.

integration_issues.flow: Copy invite link in preview env
integration_issues.issue: Clipboard receives a prod-domain URL (https://auremcto.com/...) because of the backend FRONTEND_URL fallback — root cause is backend, not frontend code. Frontend copyLink() correctly writes whatever invite_link the API returned. Rewriting the host to the preview domain works and the full accept-invite + login flow verifies end-to-end.

issues: The inline Link2 <svg> inside the helper paragraph renders on its own line (it inherits the paragraph's inline flow but visually looks orphaned between 'Use the' and 'icon next to a pending invite'). Minor polish only — consider wrapping with an inline-flex span or using   glue so it reads 'Use the 🔗 icon' on one line. Not blocking.

action_items: Set FRONTEND_URL in /app/backend/.env to the preview frontend origin (or make _invite_url derive it from the incoming request / REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL) so copied invite links work in preview out of the box. Prod is unaffected.
(Optional polish) Tighten the inline Link2 icon layout inside the helper paragraph so it stays on the same line as its surrounding text.
critical_code_review_comments: services/team_invite_email.py::_invite_url hardcodes a production URL as fallback — this is a classic source of 'invite links don't work after a stack rename / in staging' bugs. Prefer deriving from request origin or an explicit required env var that fails loudly in dev when unset.

TeamManagementPanel.jsx copyLink() surfaces a generic error toast on clipboard failure but doesn't offer a fallback (e.g., opening a textarea selection) — fine for modern browsers, but note that navigator.clipboard requires HTTPS + user gesture, which is already satisfied by the button click.
On resend, the frontend correctly re-fetches the member list via await load() so invite_link gets the new token — verified by test. Good.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Feature-under-test (Copy invite link in Team panel + strict email-binding on accept-invite) is fully working end-to-end on the frontend. Only follow-up is the FRONTEND_URL env var / _invite_url fallback issue noted above — once that's set, no further UI change is needed. The accept-invite page already strictly binds the created account to the server-stored invited email (verified by /auth/me).
